creatures.desc: The other half of the super predator duo, along with the Thrumwolf, exchanging some ferocity and durability in exchange for going for the trachea and spitting suffocating hairballs. That might not sound that dangerous but imagine having a fistful of hair pulled from a shower drain smothering your mouth, and you’ll realise that’s still not disgusting enough. But for those that it appreciates, it wi

creatures.label: spiderhorse
creatures.desc: Arachnophobia is no joke for many people, and the researcher that created this armoured arachnid had an inherent desire to share their fear with others. Granted they passed out, frothing at the mouth, when the creature emerged from the pod, but damn it it’s hard to argue with results in a riding companion that can not only keep up with the competition, but also disable them and eat them on the go

creatures.label: great devourer
creatures.desc:
Great Devourers are armoured worms known for their unquenchable appetite. Once a Great Devourer arrives, it will proceed to gorge itself on small prey, and total ecosystem collapse is almost a certainty.

Luckily, they won't attack large creatures, including humans, unless provoked. Their whole name is in fact a pun, since they are not very resilient and are easily dispatched. They have however sl

creatures.label: aiwha
creatures.desc: Aiwhas could be found on several worlds where they lived in medium-size "pods," feeding on fish and other small creatures found in or around huge bodies of water. Aiwhas are sometimes sold so as to be used as mounts on worlds that have a breathable atmosphere, and could be used for performing reconnaissance, or to traverse between two outposts without any concern for the trail or terrain.

creatures.label: bearscarab
creatures.desc:
An absolute unit of an insectoid hybrid, this massive chubster is incredibly smart and hard to kill. All the excess blubber has been replaced with either chitin or muscle fibre, so don’t go making comments about their bulk.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Very thick armour plating and a calm temperament make this hybrid an excellent combat animal. Requires little in the way of re

creatures.label: bearhorse
creatures.desc:
While they’re surprisingly tireless when they have a home to rest at, these manned mares are quite reluctant to hurry along when made to carry loads in a caravan. Their body’s efficiency means they’ll get a task done when it needs to, and not a moment sooner. What makes it worse is that they’re smart enough to know that they’re cute - and powerful - enough to get away with it.

An equine hybrid wi

creatures.label: atispec

evidence.why: venom/poison damage capacity (common; counts as a weak signal only)

creatures.desc:
Atispecs are strange semi-insectoid creatures that undergo a radical metamorphosis, similar to old terran butterflies. In their larval phase, atispecs are basically harmless: a medium-sized grub that feeds on plants and usually ends up as some predator's meal. Tens of thousands of atispec larvae hatch every season, and less than a dozen make it to their adult form.

An adult Atispec, however, is a

creatures.label: wild boar
creatures.desc:
This hairy omnivore is descended from escaped pigs and evolved for living in the wild.

Its tusks make it a better fighter than its domesticated pig cousins. Unfortunately, it is too unruly to be trained in the most complex tasks.

creatures.label: boomalope

evidence.why: detonates in a big explosion when killed

creatures.desc: Engineered for chemicals production, the boomalope grows a large sac of volatile chemicals on its back. Though it is weak and fragile for its size, other animals have learned to avoid it because of the huge explosion it produces when it dies. It can be milked to produce chemfuel - very carefully.

creatures.label: overgrown colossus

evidence.why: produces <WoodLog> — not a normal animal product

creatures.desc:
The Overgrown Colossus is a very strange beast. This gargantuan beast is one of the few creatures in the Rim that wasn't directly created by man's scientific curiosity, arising naturally in some remote swamp-filled planet, albeit from some original forgotten terran creature.

It seems to be reptilian in nature, with cold blood, a slow metabolism, and a very weird body plan: it has six legs, two in

creatures.label: sparrow
creatures.desc: Small birds that often travel in flocks. They can thrive in a variety of environments.

creatures.label: bluebird
creatures.desc: A small songbird with vibrant blue plumage.

creatures.label: crow
creatures.desc: Intelligent black birds with complex social structures. With a little patience, crows can be trained to perform a number of fairly complex tasks.

creatures.label: kiwi
creatures.desc: The miniscule, spherical cousin of the moa. Inferior in every way to their bigger relative. Helpless in the face of danger because of it's lack of flight.

creatures.label: mee scalefish
creatures.desc: A silver-blue schooling scalefish with a single line of bioluminescent dots along the flank, native to the Naboo shallows and the bulk protein of every sea that has them. A shoal scattering is the only warning some nights give.

creatures.label: phoenix owlcat
creatures.desc:
A genetically modified feline with avian characteristics, the Phoenix Owlcat was created as a durable alternative to fragile baseline cats. A loyal companion that isn't so easily hunted and slaughtered by the hostile lifeforms present on the planets of the Rim.

The ancient popular folklore of cats having nine lives was used as a pattern to create the Phoenix Owlcat: a swarm of powerful mechanites

creatures.label: turbocleaner
creatures.desc:
Basically a cleansweeper mounted on two small gyro-stabilized turbine engines. The turbocleaner hovers over terrain, using a vacuum nozzle to suction dirt and other debris. Absurdly useless in combat.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Hovers over terrain, ignoring terrain movement costs.

creatures.label: silver mole

evidence.why: gains a hediff as it is wounded

creatures.desc:
A small burrowing mammal with glistening silver fur. Elusive and skittish, the silver mole can rarely be seen outside the safety of its underground den deep in the mountains.

Many woodsmen make a habit of patrolling silver mole habitats, hoping to catch the critter while it digs for its favourite food - white truffles, rare mushrooms with sublime taste that grows under stony soils.

creatures.label: chickenffalo
creatures.desc:
You wouldn’t think something so small could eat so much, but that’s the price you pay for the sake of convenience. That convenience is sporadic, low in nutrition and very thin, an effect commonly described as “nerfing”.

An avian hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Loves to wander so it must be securely penned, but they make for a surprising pack beast. Capable of producing the holy trinity of mi

creatures.label: mecha-rat

evidence.why: dies unless its genetic timer is reset
mech hybrid — answers a mech antenna

creatures.desc:
This tiny cybernetic organism can be mass-produced as a kind of "suicide weapon". It is very fast, and armed with a short ranged stun gun, so hordes of mecha-rats can be sent to the front lines to keep enemies stunned and in check. 

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>Mechanoid hybrids are always created with a controller booster, allowing the colonists to send the mecha-rat to the front lines

creatures.label: jellybird
creatures.desc: A small floating jellyfish-like creature that hovers above the ground. They have a painful sting, and travel in flocks over the primordial geysers.

creatures.label: larva
creatures.desc: The juvenile form of larger bioengineered insects. Larva maintain and expand hives using an acidic secretion. If provoked, they defend themselves by spewing sludge.

creatures.label: prairie dog
creatures.desc: A burrowing rodent with a short tail and sharp claws used for digging. They are social animals, often living in large colonies.

creatures.label: rabbit
creatures.desc: This small and fluffy, solitary herbivore can swiftly hop away from danger.

creatures.label: faa scalefish
creatures.desc: The gold-olive scalefish — "faynaa" to the Gungans — fast, small-mouthed and predatory, taking fry and drift-shrimp in the warm water. Same dot-line as the mee; a different temper.

creatures.label: silt lamprey
creatures.desc: A black, round-mawed eel of the silt beds that latches on to whatever is bleeding — and, unlike the shrimp, does not wait for it to die. The swarm's nasty edge: the wound you took on the way down is the one it finds.

creatures.label: pale yobshrimp
creatures.desc: A pale, feather-antennaed isopod of the Naboo shallows that arrives at a carcass in dozens and leaves a clean frame. Harmless alone; the smell of blood is what makes it many.

creatures.label: kangaroo rat
creatures.desc: An odd rodent fond of warmer climates and seeds. They are capable of subsisting off of water created by their metabolism, allowing them to survive in even the most dry environments.

creatures.label: mouse
creatures.desc: A smaller relative of the world-renowned rat. They have a habit of making their way into homes and feeding on the contents of your pantry. It might be a good idea to keep a cat or two around...

creatures.label: cobra
creatures.desc: A large predatory snake. Cobras can be highly aggressive if provoked, and their bite injects toxic venom into the victim.

creatures.label: wasp
creatures.desc: A small drone used for defense and situation control. The drone injects a small amount of paralytic biotoxin, stunning organic targets. While designed to be non-lethal, wasps may occasionally kill their target by accident. Wasps are powered by a long-lasting battery.

creatures.label: rust nipper
creatures.desc: A red-shelled spiky crab with faintly glowing eyes, armored well enough to ignore a boot. Timid in ones; in a massed crawl over a wreck it turns on anything that steps in the middle of it.

creatures.label: spidermine

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <VFEP_SpiderMine> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc: Semi-autonomous combat drone with onboard pathfinding capability. Equipped with a self-destruction module and tracking system, designed to be launched as a payload and then seek out enemy targets. If no nearby targets can be acquired, it will immediately detonate in order to prevent future accidents.

creatures.label: wardrone

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <VFEP_WarDrone> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc: Semi-autonomous flying combat drone with limited combat functionality. Equipped with a lightweight semi-automatic miniturret due to limited recoil absorption and an onboard self-destruction module to both prevent enemy capture and defense against melee attackers.

creatures.label: catman

evidence.why: humanoid hybrid — works like a colonist

creatures.desc: Just the sweetest little kitty cat you’ll ever encounter, they were bred as tiny caretakers to look after people in hospital wards. Despite being a health violation, they were extremely popular with the infirms as they not only fed patients but also engaged in conversation and gave friendly headbutts. It is also alleged that their purring helped broken bones heal quicker, but no conclusive evidenc

creatures.label: chicken
creatures.desc: The most traditional farm bird, the chicken is raised for its eggs and meat. It grows very quickly and lays eggs very often.

creatures.label: catrabbit

evidence.why: gives colonists thoughts just by being near

creatures.desc:
Everyone can agree that cats and rabbits have incredibly soft fur, so can you imagine how cute and fluffy they would be if you mixed their traits together? They also love to be pet multiple times a day, so everyone can get in on this pet so fluffy it's to die for.

A feline hybrid with recessive rodent genes. While a somewhat independent carnivore, this hybrid is ideal inside a colony as it not on

creatures.label: chickenbear
creatures.desc:
For something so small, this animal has a hell of an appetite. Lacking in many departments, but the nutrition has to go somewhere and that’s for those looking for a non-vegan friendly option of getting high. The person who thought it would be a good idea to inhale the burning feathers of this plump creature is one stoners everywhere praise while they blaze.

An avian hybrid with recessive ursine g

creatures.label: chickencat
creatures.desc:
Respectably intelligent as well as lethal, these egg-laying, plump beasties love nuzzling their owners and biting their enemies. Sometimes those are different people.

An avian hybrid with recessive feline genes. Quite clean with a low gestation period, they make for an average farm animal and an average combatant with good speed. They still require a pen, so they make for good home defence.

<col

creatures.label: chickenwolf
creatures.desc:
The Tiny Terror with a disconcertingly large mouth and sharp teeth. These comic flightless web-footed little bastards may finally unwittingly help man to fathom the uncharted depths of just how dangerous they can make a living creature the size of a basketball.

An avian hybrid with recessive canine genes. Doesn’t produce much in the way of eggs but makes up for it by having a shorter gestation pe

creatures.label: mansquirrel

evidence.why: humanoid hybrid — works like a colonist

creatures.desc:
A bloody weird little thing that hates the cold with a passion, and will take any opportunity to clear away snow from its home. Given that they are active at nighttime, they make a great conversational companion for those otherwise asocial Night Owls you keep gathering.

A humanoid hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Quite quick for their size and unusually a nocturnal animal, they make for a fast

creatures.label: cleansweeper
creatures.desc: A light mechanoid designed for cleaning. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.

creatures.label: megaphorid maggot

evidence.why: evolves into a different def at an age

creatures.desc: The larval form of the megaphorid fly. It is extremely ravenous and not very dangerous on its own, but they are rarely if ever found as such. They are most often found having burst out of an infected animal.

creatures.label: cat
creatures.desc: One of mankind's first pets, the cat is a small mammal which hunts vermin. Known for their aloofness, cats are nevertheless popular companions because of their independence, calm disposition, and fine, pettable fur.

creatures.label: yorkshire terrier
creatures.desc: A small, even-tempered dog. Originally bred to hunt rats, it later became a show and companionship animal. Some consider it useless, but the mood boost it gives by nuzzling can outweigh the cost of feeding it.

creatures.label: macaw
creatures.desc: A parrot known for its intelligence and its brilliant plumage.

creatures.label: mink
creatures.desc: A small semi-aquatic mammal. The high value of its fur has resulted in mink being farmed on numerous planets.

creatures.label: porcupine

evidence.why: custom damage capacities (modded DamageDef), not plain bite/scratch

creatures.desc: A large rodent. While slow moving, it has a cloak of sharp quills which protect it from predators.

creatures.label: arctic owlcat
creatures.desc:
A strange creature combining the features of a feline and that of an owl. The nimble predator referred only as owlcats can be commonly found hunting and nesting in the woodlands. Their long elegant wings are vestigial and primarly serve in the mating season, in order to attract new partners or to scare off predators by appearing bigger than they are.

Adapted to the frozen climates, the arctic owl

creatures.label: forest owlcat
creatures.desc:
A strange creature combining the features of a feline and that of an owl. The nimble predator referred only as owlcats can be commonly found hunting and nesting in the woodlands. Their long elegant wings are vestigial and primarly serve in the mating season, in order to attract new partners or to scare off predators by appearing bigger than they are.

Some hunters have taken a liking to owlcats fo

creatures.label: catbear
creatures.desc:
The perfect companion in compact form, this tiny terror is willing to throw down with its surprising bulk. And good lord, what an affectionate beefcake.

A feline hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Can both take and dish out punishment disproportionate to its size while being clever enough to actively hunt for prey not much larger than itself. Incredibly easy to train and will intermittently dig

creatures.label: catffalo
creatures.desc:
Someone couldn’t bear being separated from their trusty feline companions when away on trips. So they decided to make one that everyone would want to take with them on long journeys. Also they look incredibly adorable with their little baggies.

A feline hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. While not great as a pack animal, they make for a fantastic caravaning companion as they will actively forag

creatures.label: catwolf
creatures.desc:
For some reason people really want cats to be able to carry stuff, depicted often in consumer media. Well this palico should have you sorted, however despite numerous efforts it has proved impossible to train them in using brooms.

A feline hybrid with recessive canine genes. An incredibly fast hauling companion that can also defend itself, these creatures borne forth from pop culture are incredib

creatures.label: otter
creatures.desc: A playful marine creature. They use tools such as rocks to crack open shellfish.

creatures.label: laa scalefish
creatures.desc: The big ornate scalefish: striped, streamer-finned, with eye-spot false faces on the tail that turn a strike the wrong way. Prized on every table that can get one; hard to net for the same reason it is hard to eat.

creatures.label: alphabeaver
creatures.desc: A large beaver-like creature genetically engineered to harvest wood with machine-like efficiency. In the absence of specialized feed, these animals will enter a manic state that compels them to eat trees whole, and are likely to attack if disturbed.

creatures.label: devil sheep
creatures.recReason: ram head on abstract red cloud

evidence.why: produces <DevilstrandCloth> — not a normal animal product

creatures.desc:
A genetically engineered sheep capable of producing extremely strong and valuable red wool. Some see a simple livestock; others, a demonic entity of corruption. Don’t listen to its whispers. Like devilstrand mushrooms, these sheep take some time to grow the fabric, but they can be easily bred to increase production as needed.

Art by Feroxiious (check her Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/fer

creatures.label: avian paragon
creatures.desc:
Sure the little blighter is more stubborn than its progenitor, but not having to gather the eggs so often and a bigger fried egg makes all the difference.

A perfect avian animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon possesses inherent wildness not present in domesticated chickens but is

creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #05618-1875 [COMPSOGNATHUS LONGIPES] CODENAME: ELEGANCE >80

A tiny bipedal carnivore that primarily eats insects and fish, yet has been observed swarming unfortunate victims in mass groups. Do not let their size - or adorableness - fool you.

creatures.label: MSE Repair Droid

evidence.why: mod wrote custom C# pawn class

creatures.desc: An MSE Repair Droid, repairs other droids within a 2 tile radius and is capable of hauling and cleaning.

creatures.label: salvage assist droid

evidence.why: mod wrote custom C# pawn class

creatures.desc: A groundmech salvage assist droid, cheap to produce but not capable of much beyond hauling and cleaning.

creatures.label: sea turtle
creatures.desc: A large marine turtle. Their streamlined shell and powerful flippers make them excellent swimmers.

creatures.label: tortoise
creatures.desc: This heavily armored land-dwelling reptile is known for its slow moving speed and surprisingly vicious bite. Because of its natural armor, it is tough to kill and can do serious damage during drawn-out melee fights.

creatures.label: armadillo
creatures.desc: A desert mammal with a leathery armour shell. The armadillo is well-adapted for defense against larger predators.

creatures.label: fennec fox
creatures.desc: A small fox originally from the northern part of Earth's Africa continent. It hunts small creatures and has very large ears for cooling itself in the heat.

creatures.label: toxafox
creatures.desc: The Toxafox is a highly intelligent fox that has evolved to survive in the harshest of environments. With a keen sense of smell, it is capable of digging up waste packs buried deep underground, making it a persistent pest. creatures.label: flamingo phoenix
creatures.desc:
- "O, His Excellency, Most High Royal Geneticist: I have laboured hard to complete your latest assignment, and it pleases me to say that I finally have results to show you."

creatures.label: badger
creatures.desc: A stocky omnivorous mammal. Badgers are surprisingly tough for their size.

creatures.label: cassowary
creatures.desc: A large flightless bird with brightly-colored feathers. While it looks beautiful, its kick is vicious. It's known for being quick to aggression when harmed by violence or confronted by incompetent animal tamers.

creatures.label: carbuncle
creatures.desc: No one is quite sure of the origin of the carbuncle - some posit they are a naturally-occurring species on some distant rimworld that glitterworlders took a fancy to and spread throughout the universe, others say they are an amalgamation of various species of Old Terra, designer-made to be adorable pets to the high classes that have since become naturalized on many worlds.  And yet others deep int

creatures.label: emu
creatures.desc: A large flightless bird with beady eyes on its ugly face. With its bad attitude, it is the jerk of the natural world. Bother it, and it is guaranteed to seek revenge.

creatures.label: fingerspike

evidence.why: vanishes on death, leaving no corpse
custom AI think tree <Fleshbeast> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc: A fleshy dog-sized creature with a single spiked limb. Despite their short legs, fingerspikes can move remarkably fast.

creatures.label: flamingo
creatures.desc: A wading bird known for their vibrant pink plumage. Their long legs are well adapted to shallow waters.

creatures.label: turkeyman

evidence.why: humanoid hybrid — works like a colonist

creatures.desc:
A cheeky little shit that likes to go around and play with switches, to satisfy their curiosity much like how an ignorant child would. Perhaps a little too smart for their own good. Their behaviour is similar to failed service animals that learn how to operate household items without restraint.

An avian hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Surprisingly hardy, quick and very intelligent, these cr

creatures.label: goose
creatures.desc: A domesticated bird kept by humans as poultry for it's eggs and meat. Lays eggs very often, however they take a long time to hatch.

creatures.label: heron
creatures.desc: Long-legged and long-necked birds. They tend to live in marshy habitats.

creatures.label: monitor lizard
creatures.desc: A large venomous lizard. They secrete toxins from venom glands in their lower jaw to neutralize their prey.

creatures.label: peafowl
creatures.desc: Large birds with extravagant plumage. Male peacocks use their tail feathers in elaborate courtship displays.

creatures.label: prowler

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <HiveMind> — it does not behave like an animal
ranged verb on the animal itself: proj Bullet_ProwlerSpit

creatures.desc: A huge and muscular monstrosity that is fiercely territorial and very aggressive. Seems to lack any greater sense of self preservation

creatures.label: swan
creatures.desc: Large graceful waterfowl known for their beauty, and their surprising ferocity.

creatures.label: barkskin dryad

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <Dryad> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc:
A dryad caste specialized in absorbing hits during combat. Barkskin dryads are covered by a thick bark-like hide which is partly formed by the Gauranlen tree itself. Under human influence, it can act as a damage-absorbing fighter.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidde

creatures.label: wolfchicken

evidence.why: custom damage capacities (modded DamageDef), not plain bite/scratch

creatures.desc:
Not many people are familiar with just how vicious a chicken can be, with them even going so far to pick at their own wounds or actively eating each other if hungry. Combining that with the sleek hunting form of a wolf and making them vegetarian creates a deadly combo. You’d go mad too if you smelled something delicious but couldn’t stomach eating it.

A canine hybrid with recessive avian genes. V

creatures.label: immature dryad

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <Dryad> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc: Dryads are small mammalian creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. This immature dryad can support and protect its tree, but its main purpose is to morph into more specialized and powerful dryad forms.

creatures.label: berrymaker dryad

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <Dryad> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc:
A dryad caste specialized in food production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate nourishing berries on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph

creatures.label: carrier dryad

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <Dryad> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc:
A dryad caste specialized in carrying items. Under human influence, it can help haul things where they need to go.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

creatures.label: clawer dryad

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <Dryad> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc:
A dryad caste with huge claws that is specialized in aggression and damage-dealing attacks. Though it can do tremendous damage, it is vulnerable to attacks itself.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <Dryad> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc:
A dryad caste with the unique ability to produce new Gauranlen pods and reproduce the Gauranlen tree along with its symbiote, the dryad queen. To do this, three gaumaker dryads must slowly merge.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph int

A dryad caste specialized in medicine production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate medicinal herbs on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph

creatures.label: woodmaker dryad

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <Dryad> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc:
A slow, bumbling caste of dryad which specializes in wood production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate a wood-like material on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.

In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden drya

creatures.label: blitzkrieg
creatures.desc: The Blietzkrieg is a unique mechanoid designed for tactical warfare and area denial. Shaped like a sleek and menacing metallic mine, it is capable of self-propelling itself to the intended target location before detonating in a devastating explosion. However, its indiscriminate detonation makes it a double-edged sword, and careful coordination is required to ensure that it does not harm friendly f

creatures.label: geneticor
creatures.desc: The Geneticor mechanoid is a humanoid robot designed for genetic engineering tasks. With advanced sensors and programming, it can analyze and manipulate DNA sequences with exceptional precision and speed. The Geneticor is equipped with a suite of specialized tools and equipment, including gene sequencers, CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing systems, and gene splicers, among others. Its programming includes a

creatures.label: guttersnipe
creatures.desc: A small, deployable combat mechanoid usually manufactured inside an ultra-heavy war empress mech. Contrary to War urchins, the Guttersnipe is a melee fighter, using its wicked circular saws to lunge at their targets. They have a non-rechargeable power source.

creatures.label: culinarius
creatures.desc: Designed for culinary arts, the Culinarius can analyze ingredients and create delicious meals with exceptional precision and consistency. The Culinarius can access an extensive database of recipes, culinary techniques, and flavor profiles, allowing it to adapt and customize its cooking style to suit any cuisine or dietary requirement. Its sturdy metal frame and robust construction make it resistan

creatures.label: bloodrop larvae

evidence.why: evolves into a different def at an age
venom/poison damage capacity (common; counts as a weak signal only)

creatures.desc: The larval form of the bloodrop moth. It gains nutrients for growth by feeding on the blood of any large creature. A small group of them can drain even an elephant to death in minutes.

creatures.label: crystalline caterpillar

evidence.why: evolves into a different def at an age

creatures.desc: The larval form of the facet moth. To deter predators, its body appears spiky and hard through a form of natural mimicry.

creatures.label: moss grub

evidence.why: evolves into a different def at an age

creatures.desc: A large beetle commonly found in dark, damp places, it feeds off low underbrush in caverns. While not the best source of meat, it works when little else is available.

creatures.label: rose flamingo
creatures.desc: Wading birds that get their color from the krill they eat by filtering food out of the water with their beaks. They thrive anywhere with warm, shallow water.

creatures.label: hunter drone
creatures.desc: An automated kill drone. The hunter drone pursues its target and detonates when it gets close.

creatures.label: gazelle
creatures.desc: A small, extremely quick antelope known for its amazingly long leap.

creatures.label: agrihand
creatures.desc: A small mechanoid designed to sow and harvest crops. While it is better suited to labor than combat, it can fight with built-in cutting blades if necessary.

creatures.label: constructoid
creatures.desc: A small mechanoid designed to perform construction tasks. It can perform blunt melee attacks if necessary.

creatures.label: fabricor
creatures.desc: A small work mechanoid designed to craft all manner of manufactured objects.

creatures.label: lifter
creatures.desc: A small mechanoid designed for hauling. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.

creatures.label: militor
creatures.desc:
A small combat mechanoid armed with a low-power mini-shotgun. Roughly four feet tall, militors lack the power, range, and toughness of more senior combat mechs. However, it is cheap to gestate and maintain, and so is often used as a rear guard or swarm attacker.

In war, mech armies are known to send militors into urban ruins to hunt down survivors after breaking the human defenses. For this reaso

creatures.label: paramedic
creatures.desc: A small mechanoid designed for non-violent emergency situation management and medical care. The paramedic can rescue the wounded, fight fires, treat the sick, and even perform surgery when a more-qualified human is not available. Its built-in jump launcher allows it to jump into, and out of, emergency situations, and its built-in firefoam popper can quickly extinguish fires.

creatures.label: war urchin

creatures.desc: An fx-7 medical droid, capable of performing medical procedures.

creatures.label: sheep
creatures.desc: Sheep husbandry is practiced throughout the majority of the inhabited worlds, however only recently it has been introduced to the rimworlds. Domestic sheep are relatively small herbivores, usually with yellowish wool and medium sized horns.

A heavily modified medium-sized wild cat, the crystalline caracal can often be seen lazying around in the sun, recharging its internal energies. creatures.label: seal

creatures.label: bearchicken

A surprisingly clean animal dubbed the “owl-bear” by those that find them amusing as they attempt to fly by rapidly flapping their stubby vestigial wings. That is until they get their eyes pecked out and flattened by their weight.

creatures.desc: Corellian hounds, also known as 'Sibian hounds' or 'Snarlers', were a type of stout canidae from the planet Corellia. They had a vicious bark and bite, which meant they could be quite effective for protection.

Some insane madman thought it would be an excellent idea to strap a flamethrower to a dog and send it out into the world to see what happens. Don’t be surprised to find out this unusual hybrid started a massive forest fire trying to hunt a rabbit.

Probably an excellent example of a precursor to the alphabeaver, this beastie has an insane appetite and constantly growing teeth that it wears down by chewing on trees. Either consider creating a tree grove just for them to eat or moving to a jungle because they’re gonna be procreating a whole bunch.

creatures.label: deer

creatures.desc: A black and white striped herbivore. They are stubborn and have never been truely domesticated.

creatures.desc: A variation of the militor and bellicor, the artilleron stands at a height of around 5 feet and it is armed with a powerful mortar that fires explosive canisters with great accuracy. It is often deployed in the front lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives. Due

creatures.label: apoptosis

Malice incarnate, the Apoptosis is an advanced Apocriton that acts as a commander designed to coordinate and motivate other mechs during long extermination campaigns. They are less adept at resurrecting other mechanoids than Apocritons, but the aura of hate they emanate is so powerful and intense that it will cause uncontrollable despair on those too close to it.

The Aura, also known as Avenging Angels, are angel-shaped mechanoids surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. The Lux's agility comes at the cost of durability, and it must rely on its speed and evasion to survive on the battlefield.

The Munifex are formidable human-sized combat mechanoids designed specifically for long-range combat scenarios. They are equipped with advanced coil lances, which are mass driver weapons that fire electromagnetically accelerated slugs at incredible velocities. These projectiles are capable of penetrating through almost any kind of defense, including thick armor plating and reinforced concrete.

The Hwacha consists of a wooden frame with a series of iron tubes mounted on top, which can hold up to 200 arrows. When fired, the Hwacha creates a very inaccurate barrage of projectiles that can inflict significant damage to enemy fortifications and troops.

creatures.label: bearwolf

Great care must be taken before considering raising this chonky boy, as they have a metabolism that matches their high ferocity and movement speed. Pretty useful in keeping egg-laying animal populations in check.

creatures.desc: A medium sized mechanoid designed to perform construction and firefighting tasks in orbit. It can perform blunt melee attacks if necessary. It is not affected by the slow space traversing speeds.

creatures.desc: A fast, human-sized combat mechanoid designed for zero-gravity warfare. While the missiles strike with lethal precision, their short range forces hunters into dangerous proximity with the enemy.

creatures.label: Charley
creatures.desc:
A general motorcycle, the Charley is a very effective single-person vehicle with a small cargo capacity. Performs well on any road except during winter season or snowy terrain, or both, with an increased speed on the world map.

creatures.label: Dirtbike
creatures.desc:
A basic off-road motorcycle, the Dirtbike is a very cheap vehicle that allows a single user to travel quickly, efficiently and quietly. Incredibly light and practically paper-thin on armour, it performs poorly in the winter or in the snow, or both, and has absolutely no cargo capacity.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances.

creatures.desc:
A juryrigged multiple rocket launcher system, the Scytheman is a repurposed farming vehicle intended to saturate a location with inaccurate volleys of explosives. Due to the design, it is not intended to fire successive volleys or be exposed to enemy fire.

creatures.label: polychoron
creatures.desc: A heavy combat mechanoid with a graser cannon that can deal massive damage to armored targets. Though it lacks agility, its graser cannon is capable of firing focused energy beams that can cut through most shielding and leave enemies defenseless.

creatures.label: sea lion
creatures.desc: A large and intelligent marine animal. Male sea lions have thick fur around their necks, which evoke a lion's mane.

creatures.label: wastedeer
creatures.desc: The Wastedeer is a unique creature adapted to thrive in the most polluted of environments. With two heads, it is capable of detecting and avoiding danger from all directions. Its mutated form has allowed it to survive in even the harshest of conditions, making it a symbol of resilience in a world ravaged by toxins. Despite its unusual appearance, the wastedeer is a graceful and nimble creature, ea

creatures.desc: A solitary and dangerous apex predator. Tigers make quick work of their prey, using a mix of stealth and razor-sharp claws.

creatures.label: alligator
creatures.desc: A large semi-aquatic reptile with a powerful bite. Alligators are slow on land, but deadly in the water.

For those who wished they could equip their canines with explosive vests, the Boomwolf stores pressurised - almost solidified - chemfuel which can be remotely discharged as a non-explosive gas. It is doubtful that one would meet a crueller or more sadistic creature than this hybrid. It actively experiences joy when slaughtering tame animals and executing prisoners, the latter of which even provides a powerful boost which can be used before battle. creatures.label: wolffalo

Just like Wooly Mammoths and Wooly Rhinos, the Wooly Wolf is a creature perfectly adapted to cold climates. Wooly wolves are an excellent source of high quality wool, since they produce it much faster than a mammoth.

Useful abilities: Fast wool production

creatures.label: panda

creatures.label: Outrigger Canoe
creatures.desc:
A watercraft featuring a lateral support float known as an outrigger, which is fastened to one of the sides of the main hull. An outrigger generates stability as a result of the distance between its hulls rather than due to the shape of each individual hull. As such, the hulls of outrigger boats are typically longer, narrower and more hydrodynamically efficient.

custom AI think tree <MO_theThing> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc: Abominations are slow, hulking, relentless manifestations of flesh. Their bodies twist and contort to heal even major wounds quickly. Their mangled maw seeps with toxic bile. They will consume and assimilate, corpse by corpse.

creatures.label: cow
creatures.desc: A very common domestic animal. It can produce large amounts of milk, or be slaughtered for delicious food.

creatures.label: hemolope
creatures.desc: Engineered for hemogen production, the hemolope grows a large sac of pure hemogen on its back. Due to genetic instabilities, unlike a boomalope, it has a very short lifespan and is generally weaker. It has rarely been encountered in the wild, as it is only kept by more ethical sanguophages for corporations for hemogen production. It can be milked to produce hemogen.

creatures.label: neutrolope
creatures.desc: Engineered for neutroamine production, the neutrolope grows a large sac of pure neutroamine on its back. Though it is weak and fragile for its size, other animals avoid it similarly to a boomalope, despite the fact it does not explode when it dies. It can be milked to produce neutroamine.

creatures.label: shale gorger
creatures.desc: The heavy benthic cousin: slate plates instead of shell, eyes long since gone pale in the dark below the silt line. It sits in scree and swallows what settles onto it. The slowest thing in the trench, and the hardest to kill.

creatures.label: Dinghy
creatures.desc:
A very basic motorised boat, the Dingy is an incredibly cheap and discrete method of transportation over water. Has a good cargo capacity, however it is likely to get frozen solid in the winter times and moves slowly on rivers. The exposed rear-mounted engine is vulnerable to attacks and the hull plating should not be expected to wither projectile weapons.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this i

creatures.label: walrus
creatures.desc: A large marine animal with tusks and whiskers. Its considerable bulk allows it to survive in extremely cold environments. While slow on land, it is relatively quick in water.

creatures.label: yooka
creatures.desc: A towering hunchbacked mammal closely related to camels and llamas. With little to no natural predators, it grazes among the taller fungi with an unconcerned grace.

creatures.label: black bear
creatures.desc: Black bears are extremely adaptable and show a great variation in habitat types, though they are primarily found in forested areas with thick ground vegetation and an abundance of fruits, nuts, and vegetation. In the northern areas, they can be found in the tundra, and they will sometimes forage in fields or meadows.

creatures.label: chimera

evidence.why: custom AI think tree <Chimera> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc:
A huge creature that resembles a disfigured combination of a bear and other animals. It is vicious without limit.

It's not known if this is a combination of natural animals or a poor imitation of animal life created by an insane machine mind.

creatures.label: manehound
creatures.desc:
Manehounds are large feral guardian dogs descended from ancient cold-climate shepherd breeds. Their dense coats, heavy neck manes and watchful posture still reveal an animal made to stand between the herd and the threat.

Generations in the wild made them cautious and territorial, but never fully erased their domestic instincts. Unlike wolves or true hunting predators, Manehounds watch, endure and

creatures.label: thrumwolf
creatures.desc: There’s a saying about the scientific community, namely “your scientists were so preoccupied with whether they could, they didn’t stop to think if they should”. This is entirely relevant to this creature, a super predator with practically no equal, a single one of these is enough to require an entire rainforest to support their daily sustenance. If that wasn’t bad enough, they were made along with

creatures.label: direhorse
creatures.desc:
Direhorses are colossal ancestral horses covered in dense coats that protect them across frozen plains and harsh open country. Their herds move over great distances at a steady pace, keeping strength and endurance where lesser mounts would quickly wear down.

Once domesticated, a Direhorse becomes one of the most valuable caravan mounts on the frontier, combining speed, carrying capacity and battl

creatures.label: Simbakub Alpha
creatures.desc:
Simbakub Alphas are rare and immense individuals, strong enough to roam alone until they find or claim a new pack. Their roars mark wide territories, and few smaller predators remain nearby once an Alpha begins to hunt.

When accepted by a pack, the Alpha becomes leader, protector and center of the collective response. Its presence reinforces the discipline of nearby Simbakubs, making coordinated

creatures.label: Mosquito
creatures.desc:
A general-purpose aircraft, the Mosquito is an extremely fast and mobile mode of transportation. While it doesn’t require a landing strip, it is slower than aeroplanes and has less cargo capacity.

Similar to other tier 2 vehicles, this has double fuel efficiency on the world map which makes them more efficient than tier 1 vehicles.

Being a flying vehicle, it is extremely obvious when on the move

creatures.label: humanoid paragon

evidence.why: humanoid hybrid — works like a colonist

creatures.desc:
There is a saying that all of life is a circle, and that eventually everything returns to its origins only to begin again. This particular humanoid has undergone some mental evolution while at the same time suffering from physical devolution, resembling more closely humanity’s distant evolutionary ancestors. Just don’t say monkey.

A perfect humanoid animal, paragon of all similar animals with no

creatures.label: bilious varog
creatures.desc: Adapted to disgustingly toxic waters, this relative of the common crocodile is highly dangerous when hungry. Alongside its razor sharp teeth, its powerful jaws also contain acid glands for drooling acid onto prey.

creatures.label: cow
creatures.desc: A large domesticated ungulate, cows have been bred for millennia to produce huge amounts of milk, meat, and leather. They are exceptionally gentle creatures and will never seek revenge, no matter how many times they are harmed. Most of them are so adapted to farm life that they cannot survive in the wild.

creatures.label: giant tardigrade
creatures.desc: A spectacularly large version of the normally microscopic creature. It is large, docile, can carry caravan goods, and can be milked for microbe squeezins.

creatures.label: wasteffalo
creatures.desc:
A large, mutated, herding herbivore descended from buffalo and adapted for high-toxicity environment. While enraged wastefallo are deadly, they can be tamed and even serve as pack animals.

The mutated secondary head makes them much more deadly, as with 2 sets of eyes and two gigantic jaws they are more than capable of defending themselves from any predators willing to hunt them.

Due to the genet

creatures.label: ronto wagon
creatures.desc:
Two rontos in front of a four-wheeled wagon with a hide roof stretched over hoops. The roof is not comfort. It is the difference between arriving and arriving with heatstroke.

Rontos are enormous, dun-coloured and profoundly nervous. They will carry a house across open pan all day and then bolt at a shadow, so the harness is built to come apart faster than it goes on, and nobody sensible sleeps u

creatures.label: dewback war chariot
creatures.desc:
A pair of dewbacks in double harness and a shooting platform braced over the axle. One hand drives; the other stands behind the rail and works whatever the clan could hang off it.

The dewbacks are the reason it works. They are slow to start and impossible to stop, they do not spook at noise the way a ronto does, and they will walk straight at something that is shooting back — which is a rarer qua

creatures.label: vekka
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

A gigantic species of baboons with an unusually prominent liking for meat.
They used to be the natural enemies of early humans, hunting them down more often than one could expect. It is possible that they could see modern humans as prey, too.

creatures.label: muffalobear
creatures.desc:
An absolute unit of a muffalo hybrid with muscles bursting underneath the layers of fur and fat. An excellent caravan companion for those wanting to transport lots of goods and hot muffalobear milk makes living in eternal winter seem almost worth it.

A muffalo hybrid with recessive ursine genes. While they are slower and eat more compared to a regular muffalo, they are better at self defence and

creatures.label: rabbitcat
creatures.desc:
For a combination of two relatively small animals, the rabbitcat is fucking massive and has a robust physique. It knows no fear and will tackle anything it wants to eat. Some say this was the other attempt to create the Rabbit of Caerbannog, because who says geneticists don’t have a sick sense of humour.

A rodent hybrid with recessive feline genes. Very intelligent considering the source material

creatures.label: Abrictosaurus
creatures.recReason: generic dino, not a named one
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #06234456-1994 [ABRICTOSAURUS CONSORS] CODENAME: WAKEFUL >532

A fast and colourful ornithopod, covered in blue and purple scales. Abrictosaurus is considered one of the few heterodontosaurids to have sexual dimorphism, as males are suggested to have longer, tusk like teeth.

creatures.label: sskarr
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #06234456-1990 [AGILISAURUS LOUDERBACKI] CODENAME: ALACRITY >391

A common sight on the rim, Agilisaurus are often seen during the evening, travelling in large groups as they speed through the grasses and foliage forging for food. Unfortunately, they often become food themselves.

creatures.label: Drinker
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #039274-1990 [DRINKER NISTI] CODENAME: IMBIBE >462

A dinosaur with quite an unusual name... until it was reclassified as Nanosaurus in 2018, alongside Othnielosaurus. The history of Nanosaurus - and the many taxonomic revisions of heterodontosaurids - is long and complicated, spanning from the 70's all the way up until today!

creatures.label: ssdarr
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #032119-1878 [DRYOSAURUS ALTUS] CODENAME: OAK >512

A small and lively ornithopod with a speckled green hide, perfect for playing hide and seek in tall grasses. They are very weak, but quite speedy.

creatures.label: vhikk
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #08721-1839 [RHAMPHORHYNCHUS MUENSTERI] CODENAME: BEAK-SNOUT >382

A small pterosaur with a long tail. Their beak, bright red in colour, is lined with needle like teeth. They use these to eat small lizards, insects, fish, and the occasional finger.

creatures.label: Tupandactylus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #03321-2007 [TUPANDACTYLUS IMPERATOR] CODENAME: SAIL >3729

A pterosaur with a big, rounded crest. These crest are often more colourful and larger in males, possibly to impress mates when the time comes.

creatures.label: harpeagle
creatures.desc:
Harpeagles are colossal birds of prey, large enough to cast shadows over herds and lift prey the size of a deer. They are feared by travelers and respected by tribes, not because they are sacred, but because few animals control the sky with such force.

Their feathers contain rare oils used to craft elixirs that sharpen the senses. Taming a Harpeagle is possible, but requires skill, courage and a

creatures.label: moose
creatures.desc: One of the largest members of the deer family, adapted to extremely cold climates. Its long legs allow it to travel easily through deep snow.

creatures.label: muskox
creatures.desc: A shaggy hoofed mammal found in colder climates. Muskox wool is known for being scratchy, but offers good protection against the cold.

creatures.label: dhakar
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Smilodon is an incredibly deadly predator, which kills its prey by holding it still with its strong forelimbs, and sinking its enormous pair of canines deep inside its neck.

creatures.label: toxscorpion

evidence.why: custom damage capacities (modded DamageDef), not plain bite/scratch

creatures.desc: The Toxscorpion is a massive and fearsome creature, growing as large as a cow. Its thick carapace and powerful claws make it nearly invulnerable, capable of cutting through even metal. With no definite weak spot, the Toxscorpion is a formidable opponent. Mutated from exposure to radiation and toxins, its stinger injects a fast-acting poison that alters the DNA of its victims. This leads to toxic b

creatures.label: Prowler
creatures.desc:
A basic off-road exploration vehicle, the Prowler is relatively cheap to construct and is an effective all-weather option for efficient travel over steep terrain. Very lightly armoured with a vulnerable rear-mounted engine, it’s best to keep this single-user automobile away from combat.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances.

<color=#bb8f04>Cre

creatures.label: thornback colo
creatures.desc: A spined, purple-dark shallows morph, shorter and faster than its pale cousin. It ambushes from wreck hulls and reef cuts and rakes with the dorsal thorns as it passes. The one you meet on the way down.

creatures.label: Highwayman
creatures.desc:
A basic infantry fighting vehicle, the Highwayman is the cheapest weaponized option for transporting three people. Hardened against small-arms fire but very vulnerable at the rear, intended to provide mobile fire support for infantry and travel quickly along paved roads.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances, however it’s also less fuel efficie

creatures.label: hippo
creatures.desc: An enormous semi-aquatic mammal with short stocky legs. While it is a herbivore, it can attack with devastating force if provoked. Its powerful jaw can crush bone and armor.

creatures.label: korrik
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant birds, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest penguin in history. While it's clearly best fitted for hunting fish, palaeeudyptes won't hesitate to take advantage of its huge size, and will attempt to hunt other vertebrates that are smaller than itself.

creatures.label: ursine paragon
creatures.desc:
The absolute alpha of units, the chonkiest of bois, winner of consecutive Fat Bear Weeks before being disqualified due to winning too often.

A perfect ursine animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon has a particularly powerful stun attack and can be slaughtered for a valuable pelt,

creatures.label: blizzarisk clutch mother

evidence.why: venom/poison damage capacity (common; counts as a weak signal only)
Alpha Animals flags this creature as having a ranged attack

creatures.desc:
Someone once thought that creating supersized spiders for hyperweave-webs production was a good idea. Their home planet is now reduced to a Marble World; a world completely purged by atomic fire. The Blizzarisk is a mutant variation of the Feralisk that has adapted to extremely cold climates

Blizzarisks attack by throwing spider webs at their prey. These huge webs both stun and freeze anyone they

creatures.label: dunealisk clutch mother

evidence.why: venom/poison damage capacity (common; counts as a weak signal only)
Alpha Animals flags this creature as having a ranged attack

creatures.desc:
Someone once thought that creating supersized spiders for synthread-web production was a good idea. Their home planet is now reduced to a Marble World; a world completely purged by atomic fire. The Dunealisk is a mutant variation of the Feralisk that has adapted to extremely hot climates.

Dunealisks attack by throwing spider webs at their prey. These huge webs stun and burn anyone they touch, all

creatures.label: feralisk clutch mother

evidence.why: venom/poison damage capacity (common; counts as a weak signal only)
Alpha Animals flags this creature as having a ranged attack

creatures.desc:
Someone once thought that creating supersized spiders for synthread-web production was a good idea. Their home planet is now reduced to a Marble World; a world completely purged by atomic fire.

Feralisks attack by throwing spider webs at their prey. These huge webs stun anyone they touch, allowing the Feralisk to close in and finish the kill with their fearsome venom laced fangs.

This Feralisk s

creatures.label: aurochs
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The ancestor of domestic cattle, the aurochs, was to modern cows what wolves are to dogs.
Larger, tougher, faster, but producing less resources and eating more than today's cattle.

creatures.label: borrak
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Daeodons are large, pig-like, omnivorous animals. However, they are much more aggressive and dangerous than regular pigs or even wild boars. Try to stay away from their gigantic maws.

creatures.label: lussik
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest mustelid ever discovered. Enhydriodon is a bear-sized ancestor of modern otters, and a very dangerous predator that used to be a big threat to early humans.
Great swimmers, surprisingly swift on land.

creatures.label: nighthrumbo
creatures.desc:
The nighthrumbo is a fearsome predator. Armed with strong jaws and its horn, as well as ranged quill attacks, it will make quick work of any prey it decides to attack. It is also a nocturnal animal, sleeping during the day and being active at night.

Useful abilities: Ranged quill attacks.

creatures.label: equine paragon
creatures.desc:
The most majestic of horses is proud and magnificent, and doesn’t care for your rules, man. So keep them properly penned up, because they’ll try to escape to freedom so they can run wild and free. And then wonder where all the carrots, sugar cubes and salt licks have disappeared to.

A perfect equine animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various imp

creatures.label: Termitotron
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #04821-2014 [TERMITOTRON VENDEENSE] CODENAME: DAMPWOOD >4910

A rather large and nasty species of proto-termite. Their insatiable appetite for wood wouldn't be so bad if their extremely powerful, clicking manidibles couldn't cut through walls and workbenches as if they were made of tissue paper. Avoid at all costs.

creatures.label: Capryak
creatures.desc:
Capryaks are megagoats of the cold regions, adapted to tundras, frostbitten forests and mountainous terrain. Their dense coats, thick hides and long horns make them resistant to cold and difficult to bring down, especially when wounded.

Colonies can raise them for rugged wool, harsh but nourishing milk, and horns strong enough for primitive weapons. The problem is keeping them: because of their s

creatures.label: duskhorn
creatures.desc:
Duskhorns are ancient herd beasts known for their deep red coats and large ivory horns that recall the last light of day. They are commonly raised by tribes and frontier settlements for the value of their wool and the dense milk they produce.

Although usually docile when kept in herds, duskhorns can become dangerous when wounded or when one of their own is threatened. Hunting them without prepara

creatures.label: centipede blaster
creatures.desc: Heavy combat mechanoids that glide on dozens of tiny legs. Their thick carapace and firepower makes them very effective against bunched-up static defenders. They are somewhat vulnerable to mobile hit-and-run tactics.

creatures.label: centipede burner
creatures.desc: Heavy combat mechanoids that glide on dozens of tiny legs. Their thick carapace and firepower makes them very effective against bunched-up static defenders. They are somewhat vulnerable to mobile hit-and-run tactics.

creatures.label: centipede gunner
creatures.desc: Heavy combat mechanoids that glide on dozens of tiny legs. Their thick carapace and firepower makes them very effective against bunched-up static defenders. They are somewhat vulnerable to mobile hit-and-run tactics.

creatures.label: megalania
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The biggest terrestial lizard of all time, as well as the biggest venomous vertebrate that's ever existed.
Because of its relatively short legs, most of megalania's prey can easily outrun it, which is why it most often has to rely on the element of surprise in its hunts.

creatures.label: jakkir
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

The largest known kangaroo that ever existed. Unlike its modern equivalents, procoptodons move around not by hopping but by walking, just like hominids.
They are very dangerous due to their ability to throw unbelievably swift punches.

creatures.label: colo claw fish
creatures.desc: A pale cave eel of the Naboo underworld, forty metres from lure to tail, with a pair of clawed forelimbs it uses to pin what its whisker-lures draw in. Its jaw distends to swallow prey larger than itself. It hunts from the dark just past the edge of your light.

creatures.label: pestigator

evidence.why: custom damage capacities (modded DamageDef), not plain bite/scratch

creatures.desc: The Pestigator is a massive and fearsome predator that reigns supreme in the polluted swamps of the rimworld. With its heavily armored form and powerful jaws, it is capable of inflicting massive damage on any opponent. Though slow on land, it is nimble and nearly invisible in water, making it a formidable adversary in its native habitat. The Pestigator is not to be underestimated, as its powerful

creatures.label: ironclad

evidence.why: gains a hediff as it is wounded

creatures.desc: A giant, genetically-engineered insectoid responsible for the hive defense. The incredible claws the size of a failed vidtuber’s ego can break and crush anything trying to harm the new spawn. Its extremely thick rock carapace makes it very slow but also very durable, but excessive damage will chip away the armor exposing the weak spots.

creatures.label: astropede
creatures.desc: Heavily armored mechanoids adapted for zero-G warfare. Astropedes drift silently through space using gravitic stabilizers, unleashing explosive kinetic barrages from their minified mass lances. Their hovering profile makes them ideal for shipboard assaults and station breaches, though their slow movement speed leaves them vulnerable to concentrated fire.

creatures.label: scarodon
creatures.desc:
Scarodons are solitary apex predators marked by saber-like fangs, robust bodies and thick fur covered in old scars. Roaming boreal and temperate forests, they are strong enough to hunt megafauna and dangerous enough to make even armed colonists hesitate.

Although they eat almost anything, Scarodons seem to prefer large and valuable prey. Bringing one down can yield rare resources, including the E

creatures.label: Roadrunner
creatures.desc:
A general cargo transporter, the Roadrunner is an excellent vehicle for getting a lot of material from one location to another. Best suited on flat roads and will struggle somewhat on hills, snow or winter tiles.

Similar to other tier 2 vehicles, this has double fuel efficiency on the world map which makes them more efficient than tier 1 vehicles. They are also less visible due to improved manufa

creatures.label: Snatcher
creatures.desc:
A general passenger transport, the Snatcher is a solid vehicle for transporting people to different locations. Best suited on flat roads and will seriously struggle in snow or on hills.

Similar to other tier 2 vehicles, this has double fuel efficiency on the world map which makes them more efficient than tier 1 vehicles. They are also less visible due to improved manufacturing.

<color=#bb8f04>Cr

creatures.label: Traveller
creatures.desc:
A basic road vehicle suited for flat terrain, the Traveller is a relatively cheap and fast option that still performs quite amicably in cold weather and snowy conditions. The light armour and exposed front-mounted engine leans to its cadence of running away from trouble rather than towards it.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances. The extra sp

creatures.label: Trawler
creatures.desc:
A general-purpose boat, the Trawler is an effective long distance transportation across open waters. Performs rather poorly on rivers and has to travel slowly during the winter season.

Similar to other tier 2 vehicles, this has double fuel efficiency on the world map which makes them more efficient than tier 1 vehicles. They are also less visible due to improved manufacturing.

<color=#bb8f04>Cre

creatures.label: muffalohorse
creatures.desc: Belligerent bulls with a penchant for the tastes of the wild wastes. A herd of these creatures can be occasionally seen trawling through regions, consuming practically all edible vegetation and leaving fertile waste in their path. Some argue that this is the ideal form of muffalo for nomad tribes, as they produce everything they need to survive winters and are large enough to feed said tribe throu

creatures.label: mace drake
creatures.desc: Despite their fierce draconic appearance, the mace drake is actually a fairly passive herbivore. However, it willingly uses its clubbed tail as a weapon if harassed.

creatures.label: bulbfreak

evidence.why: DIVIDES into copies of itself when killed
custom AI think tree <Fleshbeast> — it does not behave like an animal

creatures.desc: A horrid oozing amalgamation of many smaller fleshbeasts, all controlled by a linked nervous system. It has two large claws which it uses to tear through its victims. Bulbfreaks are often smelled before they are seen, giving off an overwhelming odor of rancid meat. They are relatively slow and easy to kill, but once they die, they explode into a horde of smaller fleshbeasts.

creatures.label: gigantopithecus
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant mammals, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

Gigantopithecus is the largest known ape that ever lived. They are highly intelligent, social creatures that feed on seeds and fruit. Thanks to their thick fur, they are quite resistant to cold - the lone specimens seen in the mountains are said to have been the inspiration to stories about the mythical Big Foot.

creatures.label: Albertosaurus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #09382-1905 [ALBERTOSAURUS SARCOPHAGUS] CODENAME: SERRATOR >92

A medium sized theropod that often hunt in small packs. They overwhelm prey with a mix of both brawn and numbers.

creatures.label: Baryonyx
creatures.recReason: hybrid read, not a named dino
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #02872-1986 [BARYONYX WALKERI] CODENAME: HOOK >60

A spinosaurid with sharp front claws and an appetite for fish and flesh. They are as aggressive as they are quick and stop at nothing during the hunt.

creatures.label: Becklespinax
creatures.recReason: dinosaur but not a named one
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #02029-21923 [BECKLESPINAX ALTISPINAX] CODENAME: HIGH-SPINE >432

A medium sized theropod a humped sail on their back. More correctly known as Altispinax dunkeri, this dinosaur had gone through significant changes in regards to identification, having once been considered a species of Megalosaurus and Acrocanthosaurus respectively. Having donned the name Becklespinax f

creatures.label: Carnotaurus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #03910-1985 [CARNOTAURUS SASTREI] CODENAME: BULL >23

A strange abelisaurids with short arms and two prognated horns above their eyes. They were incredibly powerful for the stature and size, and have been known to engage in cannibalism.

creatures.label: Ceratosaurus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #02813-1884 [CERATOSAURUS NASICORNIS] CODENAME: CRIMSON >70

A small theropod boasting cranial horns and a blood red face. They are often found wandering the wilds in family packs.

creatures.label: Cryolophosaurus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #05618-1994 [CRYOLOPHOSAURUS ELLIOTI] CODENAME: FROST >35

A unique looking theropod with small crest sitting atop it's head. It is able to tough extreme subzero temperatures due to biological alterations to its genome.

creatures.label: Desmatosuchus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #035349-1921 [DESMATOSUCHUS SPURENSIS] CODENAME: SCUTE >472

A herbivorous archosaur sporting lateral spines along its back. Often seen foraging, these strange creatures enjoy digging around in foliage with their pointed snout for the freshest mushrooms and berries. Preyed upon by many carnivores despite their jagged appearence.

creatures.label: sszhakar
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #07281-1914 [DIMETRODON GRANDIS] CODENAME: CLAMP-JAW >212

A carnivorous synapsid with a prominent sail along its back. Their jaws are incredibly powerful. Once they latch on, they ain't letting go.

creatures.label: Edaphosaurus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #0883-1940 [EDAPHOSAURUS BOANERGES] CODENAME: VERMILLION >512

A herbivorous synapsid known for lounging in the sun. Their bright red sails flare up when confronted with danger.

creatures.label: Gasosaurus
creatures.desc:
-- > BIOSYN INTERNAL CASE FILE #074638-1985 [GASOSAURUS CONSTRUCTUS] CODENAME: INCENDIARY >2

A rather small tetanuran theropod that has in-grown furuncles all over its body. These sacs ignite in a volatile explosion when the host dies.

There are rumours of specimens that explode into smoke or are able to stun people upon detonation, but most sightings are dismissed as heresay.

creatures.label: gigantophis
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #0452-1901 [GIGANTOPHIS GARSTINI] CODENAME: URUBOROS >7529

Before Titanoboa was discovered, Gigantophis was once considered the largest snake to have ever lived. The keratinous spikes that adorn this creatures hood can inflict severe cuts and slashes that can quite easily break through skin.

creatures.label: Kaprosuchus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #09372-2009 [KAPROSUCHUS SAHARICUS] CODENAME: CALYDONIAN >391

A mahajangasuchid crocodyliform with a golden, warped hide and a ferocious attitude. Their jaws are built for quickly slamming shut on prey, allowing their unfortunate victims no chance of escape.

creatures.label: Metriacanthosaurus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #03837-1923 [METRIACANTHOSAURUS PARKERI] CODENAME: AKANTHA >155

A metriacanthosaurid theropod. While dwarfed by many larger theropods, this carnivore makes up for the lack of power with speed and tenacity. Their hardy spikes make for a reliable defense against attacks from above.

creatures.label: Nanuqsaurus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #09372-2014 [NANUQSAURUS HOGLUNDI] CODENAME: KOKOGIAK >4452

A dwarf tyrannosaur covered in a downy hide of white fur. Like polar bears, it boasts black skin underneath, insulating itself for the cold boreal winters.

creatures.label: Ophiacodon

Their jaws are lined with razor sharp, needle like teeth

-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #04329-1894 [PRESTOSUCHUS CHINIQUENSIS] CODENAME: SPRINTER >222

A strange abelisaurids with short arms and two prognated horns above their eyes. They were incredibly powerful for the stature and size, and have been known to engage in cannibalism.

creatures.label: Suchomimus
creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #01997-1998 [SUCHOMIMUS TENERENSIS] CODENAME: SCYTHE >17

A spinosaurid with an agressive temper and a crooked, teeth riddled maw. Their arched neck allows them to strike quickly, and their claws are perfect for slicing up fish - or colonists.

creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #029341-1952 [TANYSTROPHEUS GRANDIS] CODENAME: COBRA >382

creatures.desc:

A gigantic species of snake that could reach up to 12 metres long and weighed nearly 1,135 kg! Despite their tendency to hunt on land, Titanoboa was thought to be primary piscivorous.

creatures.desc:
-- > INGEN INTERNAL CASE FILE #04729-2015 [YUTYRANNUS HUALI] CODENAME: BEAUTY >422

A medium sized theropod with a hide speckled with filamentous feathers that align down its back. It is able to survive in colder climates than most species.

creatures.label: tunneler
creatures.desc: A heavy mechanoid built for mining in treacherous locations. While intended for excavation, the tunneler's gigantic power claws and ultra-thick armor makes it a dangerous force in combat.

creatures.label: sskorrak
creatures.desc:
Long extinct giant reptiles, brought back to life as a part of the Megafauna Project.

This terrestrial crocodile possesses long legs, which render it much better of a runner than its modern equivalents.
Quinkana's teeth are shaped like knives, which makes them perfect for practically cutting away parts of its prey.

creatures.label: Bang Bus
creatures.desc:
A basic passenger transport, the Bangbus is a relatively cheap piece of machinery to construct to transport people across roads of flat terrain. Not recommended to use in the winter season or in snowy terrain, or both, as the light plates of armour that protect the passengers similarly negatively affects its acceleration.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for m

creatures.label: Bunsen
creatures.desc:
A basic light tank, the Bunsen is a modified armoured vehicle suited for taking on enemy fortifications and exposed infantry. Special light plating to prevent self-immolation, combined with its main weapon drawing directly from its enlarged fuel tanks, leave it a very precarious model to field.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances, however it’

creatures.label: Mule
creatures.desc:
A basic cargo transport, the Mule is a relatively cheap vehicle that can carry a large amount of cargo across smooth roads of flat terrain. Not recommended to use in the winter season or in snowy terrain, or both, and it is very lightly armoured to save weight.

Similar to other tier 1 vehicles, this is a gas guzzler and best used for medium distances. Unlike other tier 1 vehicles, this one perfor

creatures.label: Roadkill
creatures.desc:
A basic medium tank, the Roadkill is a comparatively cheap armoured vehicle suited for short engagements. Very respectfully armoured from frontal attacks, however side attacks can disable movement and the exposed rear-mounted engine makes it vulnerable to flanking.

While other tier 1 vehicles are gas guzzlers, this one burns through fuel at an alarming rate and is extremely slow to repair.
